risk_if_not_implemented: Without Personal Data Process Manager (PDPM), Personal Data (PD) may be collected, processed, retained or shared without lawful authority or adequate safeguards, harming individuals and exposing the organization to regulatory action. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Regulatory / Legal / Contractual Financial Liability (R-EX-5), Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Privacy Harm / Unauthorized Processing (R-IP-6), Loss of Critical Knowledge / Capability (R-PE-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Sensitive / Regulated Data Governance
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate data governance so that sensitive and/or regulated data is effectively managed and maintained in accordance with applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual obligations.
compensating_control_1.justification: Sensitive / Regulated Data Governance (DCH-03) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Personal Data (PD) Process Manager (PRI-03.3) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Data Privacy Program
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation and operation of data protection controls throughout the data lifecycle to ensure all forms of Personal Data (PD) are processed lawfully, fairly and transparently.
compensating_control_2.justification: Data Privacy Program (PRI-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Personal Data (PD) Process Manager (PRI-03.3) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
